What A SMART Repair Is

SMART stands for Small to Medium Area Repair Technology. It is a way of fixing the everyday damage a car picks up: scratches, bumper scuffs, small dents and marks in the paint.

We only work on the damaged area. We prepare the surface, match the paint to your car, then blend the new paint into the old so you cannot see where the repair starts. Because we are not redoing the whole panel, the job is normally quicker and cheaper than a full bodyshop repair.

Everdent SMART is run by the same hands as Everdent PDR. One number, one person, and a straight answer on which repair your car actually needs.
  • Paint work and wheelsBumper scuffs, scratched panels, blended repairs and alloy wheel refurbishment, all from the same van.
  • Based in Holt, out across WiltshireMelksham, Trowbridge, Chippenham, Corsham, Devizes, Calne and Bradford on Avon.

What To Expect

Here is how a job runs, in plain English.

  • You send a photoSend a picture of the damage, or ring us. We will tell you whether a SMART repair is the right fix, or whether something else will suit the car better.
  • You get a price firstWe give you a price before anything is booked in. That is the price you pay. If the damage turns out worse than the photo showed, we talk to you before we start.
  • We prep and match the paintThe area is cleaned and prepared, then the colour is matched to your car using the paint code and checked against the panel in daylight.
  • We blend it in and you check itThe new paint is blended into the old so there is no hard edge, then finished and polished. You look it over before we call it done.

Most jobs are finished the same day. Alloy wheels are usually done in a day as well, though a full set takes longer than a single wheel.

FAQ - SMART & Alloy Wheel Repairs

That is the whole job. We start from your car's paint code, then check the mix against the panel in daylight before any of it goes on. The new paint is then blended out into the old paint rather than stopped at a hard line, so your eye does not catch the join.

Most single repairs are done in a day. A bumper corner or a flat and polish can be quicker than that. A full set of alloy wheels takes longer than one wheel, so we will tell you the timing when we give you the price.

Yes. Kerb rash along the rim is one of the most common jobs we get. The wheel is prepared, repaired and refinished. If you want it in a different finish, satin, shadow or smoke are all options at the extra cost shown above.

Then we look at both. Sometimes the dent comes out first without any paint at all, which is the PDR side of the business, and then only the scratch needs painting. That normally works out cheaper for you, and we will say so rather than quoting you for the bigger job.

Usually, yes. A bodyshop often takes the whole panel back and repaints all of it. We work on the damaged area only, so there is less materials, less labour and less time. It is not right for every job, and if your car needs a full panel doing we will tell you straight.

Some jobs can be done at your home or work. Paint needs the right conditions to go on properly, so heavier repairs and wheel refurbishment are better done at our place in Holt. Send a photo and we will tell you which yours is.
